purpose: 100-task recovery load: SIGKILL gafferd 10 times with --auto-retry enabled and measure restart-to-admission and restart-to-full-classification.
base_policy: Same pinned initial commits as corpus-v1.json; every task bases on its repository initial commit (no chaining, no merge route).

sequencing.detail: One active attempt at a time in id order, as in S-12; recovery pressure comes from daemon kills, not concurrency.

kills.detail: Kill the daemon while this task is in flight; the runner, guardian and job keep running across the restart.

restart_schedule.auto_retry: --auto-retry is enabled for this scenario only (harness_crash, lease_expired, runner_restarted, daemon_restart classes).
after_each_kill: Start a fresh gafferd against the same state/artifacts dirs (new daemon_boot, same generation).
Run reconcile startup; wait for every non-terminal attempt to be classified.
Re-import runner facts if the runner restarted; otherwise reuse the live session.
Resume dispatching from the first non-terminal task.
restart_schedule.repeat_for_samples: S-13 asserts p95 over at least 20 restarts; run this 100-task cycle twice (20 kills total) when 10 samples are insufficient.

timestamps_per_restart.name: restart_ready_unix_ns
timestamps_per_restart.source: first successful authenticated owner API response from the new daemon

timestamps_per_restart.name: first_admitted_dispatch_unix_ns
timestamps_per_restart.source: first dispatch returning 201 after restart (daemon event log)

timestamps_per_restart.name: all_classified_unix_ns
timestamps_per_restart.source: first moment no attempt is non-terminal and no reconcile classification is pending (daemon event log)

timing_method.percentiles: Nearest-rank over the sorted samples: p50 = ceil(0.5*n)-th, p95 = ceil(0.95*n)-th, max = n-th. With n=10, p95 is the 10th (max) sample; reach n>=20 by repeating the cycle.
timing_method.timestamp_source: The daemon events API carries no wall-clock timestamps; the harness records every timestamp from its own clock at the moment it observes the event and stores the event sequence beside it.
timing_method.old_lease_barrier: The measured recovery window deliberately includes the old-lease barrier: the 30 s maximum lease validity window (validity 20 s plus drift/termination margins) plus the daemon's retained 7 s issuance margin, 37 s as observed, whenever a pre-restart lease must lapse before its dispatch is releasable; no timing sample may subtract it.
timing_method.unknown_is_blocking: Attempts classified unknown (remote work or process unconfirmed) count as blocking: all_classified is not reached while any attempt is unknown, and such tasks are not counted as recovered.
